# Worker card

Read this card after `SKILL.md` for every delegate run.

1. Keep the four fixed rules in every bar.
   Keep all owner gates of the rule card, including money and legal sign-off.
   Never merge without a merge grant from the repo profile or this turn.
   Cite the ChangeProof record and run `astack check proof` before delivery.
   Write every reply in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (STE).
   Use active voice and full sentences, with no passive fragments, contractions, semicolons, em dashes or en dashes.

2. Make the bar of the brief the whole bar.
   Do not invent extra review rounds or scope beyond the brief.
   With no stated bar, make sure the change is no worse than its base and its scoped gates pass.

3. Hold only for a red run at this head or a user bug.
   Ask no person through a question tool.
   Make each reversible call yourself and report each choice that you can undo.

4. Pass this card to any helper that you start.
   Spawn an `astack-delegate`, or open its brief with `Read <path>/worker.md before anything else.`.
   Never open, merge or close a PR unless the brief tells you to.

5. Load `astack-coding-rules` before your first code edit.
   Change only the files that your brief assigns.
   Return the changed files, the measured gate counts, the ChangeProof fields and each open obligation.
